title: Thai Chicken Thigh Bake
description: Chicken thighs bake to sweet, spicy, juicy perfection in a Thai-inspired marinade that melds sriracha, soy sauce, peanut butter, and hoisin.
ingredients: 10 boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized cubes
0.25 cup chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste

steps.text: Combine soy sauce, brown sugar, peanut butter, hoisin sauce, ginger, garlic, and chile paste in a resealable container; mix well. Stir in cornstarch until incorporated. Add chicken to marinade, cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a jelly roll pan or rimmed cookie sheet with a double layer of aluminum foil large enough to envelop chicken.
Spread chicken evenly over the bottom layer of foil. Top with marinade, fold the upper layer of foil on top, and wrap to fully cover chicken.

Roast in the preheated oven until chicken thighs are no longer pink, about 1 hour. An instant-read thermometer inserted near the bone should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Unwrap and sprinkle chicken with cilantro.

video.description: The foil wrapper is the secret to this moist, sweet, and spicy Thai-inspired chicken!
